name: BetterLife-Omarchy
author: codezilla
description: A bundle of macOS-flavoured quality-of-life additions for the Omarchy shell: a glass dock, a Super+Tab app switcher, a Mission-Control-style workspace viewer, a compact workspaces bar widget and an AI-agent limits bar widget.

barWidget.description: Pick the module in the widget settings: "workspaces" (only used workspaces, renumbered) or "limits" (Grok/Claude/Codex limits and session tokens). Add the widget once per module.
